bio.text: Rob Long represents District 90 in the Florida House of Representatives.
Long served on the Delray Beach City Commission from 2023 to 2025, as vice mayor, and chaired the Palm Beach County Soil & Water Conservation District from 2016 to 2023.
Long is an engineer who lives in Delray Beach, holds a civil engineering degree from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Florida, and moved to Florida in 2008.
